high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic close-up of a tear falling from a person's eye in low light.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A completely black background with dramatic shadows and depth, teal-blue color grading, shot in widescreen cinematic format with black letterboxing on both sides.

elements.desc: A person's eye partially visible with the iris and pupil in sharp detail, and a single illuminated tear falling, reflecting light.
